evidence.description: Checkable citation: file:line-range, command output, doc section. Empty or uncheckable evidence causes the runner to force support_level to 'unsupported'.

deciding_evidence.description: What concrete evidence would settle this finding. Required at close for any finding still rejected/disputed.

reason.description: accept: what evidence changed your mind. partial: which components are accepted vs rejected, and why. reject: why the claim fails.

evidence.description: Checkable counter-evidence. REQUIRED by the runner when verdict is 'reject'.

contest_support_level.description: Optional: contest the opponent's self-assigned support_level for this finding.

proposed_fix.description: Optional concrete fix proposal for accepted findings. Proposal only; Review mode never applies changes.

deciding_evidence.description: When maintaining a dispute (verdict 'reject'/'partial' on your own contested finding, or rejecting the opponent's), name the concrete evidence that would settle it.
